summary: 27-year-old Boulder man suffered a significant lower leg injury hiking near Lake Haiyaha; litter-evacuated to Glacier Gorge Trailhead, then taken by personal vehicle for further care.
location: Lake Haiyaha, Bear Lake area, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: Source: Estes Park News, "Six Incidents in Rocky Mountain National Park on Tuesday, August 14, 2012" — one of six same-day RMNP incidents; the Broadway Ledge pair from the same article is id 3086.
